mike_sales: Heads-up: NimbusX POC seeing spikes of 429s + a few 503s during scripted ramp. Demo in 30m. Can ops/eng triage?

tara_oncall: On it. route + model? any example req ids/logs?

mike_sales: route=/v1/generate model=redwood-lite sample req=req_c3f2. log:
```
WARN 429 RateLimit account=nimbusx req=req_c3f2 reason=burst
ERROR 503 GatewayFailure req=req_c3f2 module=kvcache fetch_failed
```

sam_runtime: 503 + kvcache msg could be cache shard pressure. 429s look like burst bucket exhaustion from generator.

leila_se: recommend immediate soft throttle and advise linear backoff client-side. I'll DM a minimal retry snippet.

tara_oncall: applied temp throttle (account=nimbusx max_rps=120) at 11:03 UTC. monitoring. ops-bot: note throttle applied.

ops-bot: throttle rule updated for account=nimbusx by tara_oncall at 11:03:12 UTC

mike_sales: customer accepted slowing ramp to 120rps for demo. they also asked about short-term burst pricing and EU-only data.

nadia_compliance: hosted inference can route to EU region; logs may be processed centrally—I'll confirm retention and EU-only guarantees with legal and revert.

sam_runtime: opened ENG-7564 to investigate kvcache tuning and add a warmup token for trials. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-7564 (assigned infra/eng-runtime). ETA: 72h for proposal.

leila_se: sent client backoff snippet and quick troubleshooting checklist (ntp, token refresh).

tara_oncall: metrics after throttle: 429s dropped from ~6% to <0.2%, 503s near zero. monitoring for 30m.

mike_sales: i'll own customer comms and pricing follow-up. please post any prod changes here. thanks everyone :pray:
